# TripCheck Japan

> TripCheck Japan is an English-first Tokyo trip builder and route optimizer. It turns an unordered list of places, an optional hotel and flight times into geographic day groups, hotel-aware routes, transport choices and airport-safe travel days.

## Canonical pages

- English: https://tripcheck-japan-tokyo.syoki.chatgpt.site/
- Japanese: https://tripcheck-japan-tokyo.syoki.chatgpt.site/ja
- Korean: https://tripcheck-japan-tokyo.syoki.chatgpt.site/ko
- Simplified Chinese: https://tripcheck-japan-tokyo.syoki.chatgpt.site/zh

## What the product builds and checks

- Geographic day groups from an unordered Tokyo wishlist
- An efficient visit order and planning timeline for every day
- Walking, train and taxi estimates with fastest and recommended separated
- Hotel-area recommendations based on the entered wishlist's total travel
- Hotel-aware routes that start and end at the recognised base
- First-day start and last-day deadline from Haneda/Narita flight inputs
- Airport processing, early-arrival and city-transfer planning buffers
- Geographic relationship and a shorter order for supported Tokyo stops
- Explicit-time gap checks using editable stay assumptions and planning travel estimates
- Cross-city travel and poor geographic grouping
- Hidden station walking and transfer overhead
- Queues and missing buffers around timed-entry reservations
- Daily stop density and traveler energy load
- Whether a calmer order can preserve confirmed tickets and must-do places

## Differentiation

TripCheck is not a destination-discovery chatbot or a map replacement. Deterministic code handles location order, feasibility, time, cost, confidence and later expense settlement. AI is reserved for ambiguous language and explanation. Google Maps is the user-chosen exit for live directions.

## Current limitations

The public planner is free. It recognises a small source-attributed Tokyo catalog and five hotel areas, clusters and orders known stops, compares planning transport estimates and applies optional Haneda/Narita flight boundaries locally without uploading the input. Unknown entries are retained rather than guessed. Hotel ranking is geographic, not a price, quality or commission ranking. The planner is not connected to live opening hours, ticket or hotel inventory, weather, traffic, or train routing. Prototype estimates must not be treated as verified travel facts.
